label: Let's Begin
heading: Let's Build Your PV & LGSF Project
subtext: From solar car park structures to fully engineered light-gauge steel buildings — our team handles design, fabrication, and on-site erection across North India. Tell us about your site and we'll come back with a feasibility + cost plan within 48 hours.

features.title: Custom-Engineered
features.description: Every structure is engineered to the design loads of the project, including snow, wind, and seismic conditions specific to your site.

features.title: AZ 150 Galvalume
features.description: All structural members use Zinc + aluminium coated steel (AZ 150) with yield strength ≥ 550 MPa — built for decades, not years.

features.title: Fast On-Site Erection
features.description: Factory-made panels are delivered ready to bolt. Typical LGSF structure: ground + floors in weeks, not months.

features.title: Earthquake Resistant
features.description: LGSF's light weight + high strength gives excellent earthquake resistance — ideal for difficult terrains including mining sites.
